title: Pan2025
description: A cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 10 healthy participants who performed cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery across two sessions. Recordings used 28 EEG channels at 250 Hz. In session 2, the test trials gave online feedback. The dataset supports research on cross-session decoding and brain-computer interface benchmarking, and is distributed in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier using 28 channels in a 10-10 montage at 250 Hz, with online bandpass filtering of 0.01-200 Hz and a 50 Hz notch. Each session had about 180 cued left- or right-hand motor imagery trials (4 s rest, 4 s task). In session 2, the first 30 trials were used for training and the remaining trials were used for testing with online feedback.
